title: Phase 2 feasibility metrics vs word-for-word baseline (JAK-41)
gate_rationale: Official Thomas 7 surviving-letter scores are gate-blocked (review_status='ready-for-independent-review'); cannot claim G-witness feasibility on a completed human-checked gold.
NT holdout gold remains 'provisional-draft' — useful for relative decoder-vs-baseline comparison, not as a final OKR.
NT holdout macro mean letter F1 for decoder≈0.1187 (baseline≈0.1029; delta≈+0.0158).
Jake Phase 2 note: corpus/morphology gaps are still the likely limiting factors; absolute recovery is far from production-scale.
Decoder is only marginally better than the elementary word-for-word baseline on identical inputs — not yet a clear architecture win.
Ollama (JAK-42) stays deferred: limitation is evidence/eval readiness and morphology/corpus depth, not a demonstrated need for LLM fill-in.

notes: Official Thomas 7 surviving-letter scores require human-checked + freeze.
ready-for-independent-review is packaged readiness only — not completed review.

eval package 'thomas-7-blinded-eval-v1' has review_status='ready-for-independent-review'; JAK-40/41 scoring requires review_status='human-checked' after an independent review (reviewer, date, inspected witness/source version, surviving-letter-vs-restoration decisions). 'ready-for-independent-review' is packaged readiness only — not a completed review. Formal follow-up: complete independent review before scoring (tracked under JAK-43 eval-readiness; do not invent human-checked).

failure_modes.detail: JAK-37 lemma proxies are accent-stripped surfaces, not MorphGNT lemmas; surface_exact and lemma_proxy often coincide, so inflection errors are under-measured.
Frequent Greek function word predicted where gold differs (bag co-occurrence / NT prior risk).
High Coptic coverage with low letter F1 — emitting familiar NT Greek that does not match this holdout.
Lowest letter-F1 holdout unit — length/content mismatch.
Fluent or NT-like Greek must not be treated as reconstruction success; surviving-letter / multi-level metrics are authoritative.
P.Oxy. 654 Thomas 7 lines mix sparse surviving letters with restorations; restorations stay out of gold. Official agreement deferred until independent review.
Word-for-word baseline covers more Coptic surfaces but does not beat decoder letter F1 — coverage ≠ fidelity.
Blinded Thomas 7 decoder vs word-for-word on identical Dilley Coptic; official surviving-letter comparison deferred.

metric_definitions.letter_agreement: Token-positional Greek letter F1/precision/recall (``token-positional-letter-v1``). Global LCS is diagnostic only.
metric_definitions.surface_exact: Positional exact match after letter-fold (casefold + strip diacritics + letters only). Recall = exact hits / gold tokens.
metric_definitions.lemma_proxy: Positional match of JAK-37 ``infer_greek_lemma`` proxies (NFD strip combining marks). Not MorphGNT lemmas.
metric_definitions.lemma_lcs: Longest common subsequence length of lemma-proxy sequences / gold token count — order-preserving content recovery beyond strict index.
metric_definitions.near_miss_tokens: Positional pairs with shared letters but not exact surface match (weak morphology / near-miss signal under the letter-fold proxy).
metric_definitions.word_order: Captured jointly by positional lemma_proxy recall and lemma_lcs recall; fluent reordering that loses position lowers positional scores even when LCS stays high.
metric_definitions.phrase_fidelity: For multi-token JAK-38 construction spans: whether the predicted Greek surface sequence appears as a contiguous gold subsequence (letter-folded). Baseline is always singleton 1:1.
metric_definitions.additions_omissions: additions = unpaired hypothesis tokens; omissions = unpaired gold tokens (length mismatch after flattening non-null predictions).
metric_definitions.uncertainty: Decoder abstention rate + mean top-1 candidate uncertainty when candidates exist. Baseline uncertainty is coverage-only (null = unseen).
metric_definitions.surviving_letter_thomas7: Official Thomas 7 surviving-letter agreement requires ``review_status=human-checked`` + freeze pin (JAK-40). Gate-blocked status is reported honestly; not invented.
